title: The Seven Trumpets
description: After the Lamb opens the seventh seal, there is silence in heaven, and seven angels each receive a trumpet. The first four trumpets strike the earth, sea, rivers, and heavenly bodies with hail, fire, blood, and darkness. The fifth releases locusts from the abyss who torment people, and the sixth frees four angels at the Euphrates who kill a third of humanity. In the interlude, John eats a small scroll that is sweet in his mouth but bitter in his stomach, and the two witnesses prophesy, are killed, and rise again. When the seventh angel sounds, it is declared that dominion over the world belongs to God and his Anointed One. [ref:Rev 8-11|Revelation 8-11]
